artworks.title: View of Washington
artworks.medium: chromolithograph with watercolor additions on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (trimmed): 45.72 × 68.58 cm (18 × 27 in.)
sheet (trimmed): 53.34 × 68.58 cm (21 × 27 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of Washington city, showcasing a detailed cityscape. A large building with arches, a domed roof, and two flags is featured prominently. Horse-drawn carriages and people are visible nearby. The streets are orderly, lined with trees, leading to a central open area with a tall monument. The horizon separates the sky from the urban and natural landscape. The color palette includes warm earth tones, greens for the trees, and cooler blues for the sky and water. The illustration is detailed, capturing architectural and landscape features accurately.

artworks.title: La Mère Gérard
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure in full body. The person is slightly turned to the side, with their left arm hanging at their side and the right arm holding fabric or a garment. The facial features are partially obscured by shading, with curly hair peeking from under a cap or bonnet. The attire consists of a long-sleeved shirt, a short dark cape or shawl, a long skirt, and cloth shoes. The background is lightly sketched to suggest a wall or texture, with shadows to the right of the figure. The lower part of the sketch includes the artist's inscription and other annotations.

artworks.title: Seymour Standing Under a Tree
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Mary E. Maxwell, 1949)
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing near a large tree on grassy ground. The individual is leaning against the tree, looking upwards with a neutral expression. They have short tousled hair and are dressed in a knee-length coat, a dress or skirt, stockings or knee-high socks, flat shoes, and a hat with a brim. The background includes a wooded area with trees and a body of water reflecting the scene.

artworks.title: Mother and Child, No. 1
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: In this sketch, a woman is seated in a slightly reclined position, holding a child on her lap. The woman's features are softly drawn, with her head tilted towards the child. She wears a headdress and a long gown or dress. The child is unclothed and nestled against the woman, with an arm around her neck. The background is minimally detailed, showing abstract outlines of possible furniture.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person shown in a profile view. The person is depicted in a dynamic, slightly crouching position with their hands in front of them. The facial features are delicately drawn, showing a smooth profile with a slightly downward gaze. The person has long hair that is flowing back, partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is unclothed, and no jewelry is visible. The background is plain, allowing focus to remain on the details of the drawing and the texture of the paper itself. The paper is a neutral-toned canvas that serves as the backdrop for the sketch.

artworks.title: Aaron Converting His Staff into a Serpent
artworks.medium: ink and graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1950)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person standing. The individual has one arm raised in front of them, and the other arm is holding a staff upright. The person's facial features include a prominent nose, closed eyes, and a long beard. Their hair is wavy and flows around their face. They are dressed in loose, flowing robes that drape around their body, reaching down to their feet, leaving their toes visible. The background is minimal, with sketching around the person, including a serpent-entwined staff on the left side. The drawing is monochrome with varying shades, and there is a scribbled design in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Study for Figure above "Music"
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a male figure from the torso upwards in a dynamic pose. The person is seated with one knee drawn up and arms raised. The facial features are softly sketched, focusing on the eyes, nose, and slightly parted lips, framed by short, combed-back hair. The figure's musculature is accentuated, giving a sense of realism. The sketch has a plain background, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. It is executed on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed"
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts six different views of a person's head and upper shoulders. Each view shows the head turned at varying angles with the individual wearing a band around their eyes, functioning as a blindfold. The band is tied at the back of the head, displacing some strands of hair. The person's hairstyle is short and neat, with varying levels of detail in different sketches. The artwork is in a monochrome style, likely using pencil or charcoal, emphasizing shadows for a realistic portrayal. The background is a simple neutral tone without any additional elements.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up of a person's head and a portion of the neck, with the face shown in profile. The person appears to be in a downward position with a relaxed, contemplative expression, and dark, smooth hair frames the face. The individual is dressed in formal attire, noted by a visible collar and tie. The background consists of a smooth, untextured surface. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held in this sketch.

artworks.title: On the Bridle Path, Central Park, New York
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, wash, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Arthur C. Nash, 1962)
artworks.description: The image portrays a person riding a horse. The rider faces away from the viewer, with their head slightly turned. The rider wears dark riding clothing and a wide-brimmed hat, with short hair visible. The horse is depicted in an active pose, with legs stretched out. The reins are held by the rider, showing control. The background is plain and light brown. The artwork is signed by Frederic Remington in 1889.

artworks.title: Mending Nets on the Hudson River, New York
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, through a gift of Florence Tucker Spaulding, 1981)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with hills, a boat on the water, a twisting tree on the left, a group of figures near the water, an archway, a large rock, and trees on the right bank. The color palette is soft with blues, greens, and browns. The sky is mostly clear with a few clouds.

artworks.title: The Great East River Suspension Bridge: Connecting the Cities of New York and Brooklyn
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1952)
artworks.description: This print shows a large bridge over a wide river, seen from a slightly elevated view. The tall stone pillars and suspension cables of the bridge take up most of the upper half of the print. Below them, a cityscape is visible along the horizon to the right. Closer to us, sailboats and larger boats with smokestacks cross the light blue water. In the bottom left corner, the tops of buildings from the near side of the river are visible, with tiny depictions of people, horses, and carriages on the street far below. The sky is light blue at the top of the print, fading into white toward the horizon.

artworks.title: Battle Charge
artworks.medium: black ink wash with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association, 1951)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military skirmish. The scene depicts soldiers holding rifles with bayonets attached, in a moment of high tension and action. Soldiers are positioned at various angles, suggesting movement and chaos typical of battle. In the foreground, a soldier is holding a flag, surrounded by fallen comrades. The background shows more soldiers, some mounted, with flags and weapons raised, adding depth and dynamism. The monochrome palette and detailed shading emphasize the dramatic and historical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Gretchen Murdering Her Child
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene with a figure bathing in a pond. The drawing features light pen and ink outlines depicting a central figure immersed in water, surrounded by tall grasses and trees in a natural setting. Additional figures or mythical creatures are outlined in the background among the trees. The upper portion of the drawing is largely bare, with a light sketch of a face and lines.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait: Interior of My New York Apartment
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William L. Harding, 1979)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior room with vibrant decor. The scene is showcasing a living room or sitting area with soft visible brushstrokes that bleed together. A blue sofa is on the left, with a person sitting on it with their legs crossed, appearing to read a large green book. In the center, there is a wooden table with a colorful cloth, a bouquet of flowers in a green vase, and a bowl of orange objects. The table has two large windows behind it. Light filters through large purple curtains, casting shadows on the floor. Bowls and vases are arranged on the windowsill. The dominant colors are deep blue and gray with hints of purple and orange.

artworks.title: Studies for "Judgment"
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Detail of the Track at Leland Stanford's Horse Farm in Palo Alto
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Charles Isaacs)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a horse standing on a surface with a sloping wall as a backdrop. The horse is well-groomed and attentive, with a lead line extending horizontally. The background and floor have geometric lines which contrast with the organic form of the horse. The sloping wall has a sequence of numbers along its base. The photograph is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Detail of the Track at Leland Stanford's Horse Farm in Palo Alto
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Charles Isaacs)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a horse hitched to a two-wheeled carriage. The scene shows a light-colored horse standing still as it is bound to a simple carriage with large spoked wheels. The backdrop consists of a wooden fence or a rough wooden building. The horse is outfitted with leather harnesses linked to the carriage, and the surface on which they stand appears to be flat and light-colored. There are markings and spots on the photograph. The image has an antiquated quality, typical of 19th-century horse-and-buggy depictions.

artworks.title: Interior of the Camera Shed at Leland Stanford's Horse Farm in Palo Alto
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Charles Isaacs)
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of an old wooden structure with slanted beams and a loft-like space. Various objects like boxes and bottles are scattered around. The color palette is sepia-toned, with light streaming in through gaps in the wooden walls and ceiling. Handwritten annotations over the scene indicate areas such as "where camera was placed," "developing shelf," and "old shutters."

artworks.title: The Corcoran Gallery of Art
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the Corcoran Gallery of Art. The drawing shows an ornate building with a grand architectural design, surrounded by several trees. The building showcases a classical style with intricate detailing on its facade, including decorative columns and a domed roof. The image is framed with an artistic border, which includes a stylized depiction of leaves and scrolls. At the bottom of the frame, the text reads "The Corcoran Gallery of Art."

artworks.title: Marbles
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a cushioned chair. His upper body and part of his lower body are visible, in a relaxed, slightly reclined position. The man has a distinguished facial profile with a furrowed brow and an intense gaze, with neatly styled hair. He is wearing a robe with ornate details. A large unfolded newspaper is draped over him. The background fades into sketch-like lines, leaving it blank, emphasizing the figure in the chair. The sketch has a graceful simplicity.

artworks.title: Bronzes
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a lion lying on a ledge. Beside the lion, there are various ornate plates and vases arranged intricately. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink lines on a white background. The lion is positioned near the top left corner of the image, facing downward. The decorative items are clustered behind the lion to the right. On the left edge, there is an elaborate architectural column with a helmeted head sculpted into it.

artworks.title: Branch
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: In the image, there is a botanical drawing of a vertically oriented stem with leaves spreading outwards. The drawing is in black ink on an off-white background. The stem curves diagonally upwards to the right and inwards to the left, with the main features in the upper half of the image.

artworks.title: Casts from Antique Sculpture: The Parthenon
artworks.medium: offset lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The artwork features two sculptures depicted in a black and white drawing. The upper sculpture portrays a seated figure from the side with emphasis on muscular build and draped clothing against a detailed bas-relief showing multiple figures. The seated figure appears relaxed but attentive. Below, another sculpture is illustrated, featuring a standing male figure on a small pedestal in a contrapposto stance with muscular definition. The drawing emphasizes contrast and shadow, presenting the sculptures in a classical style.
